d: Lateef Bhat Encounter: Lashkar commander Lateef Ahmad Bhat was killed after a gunfight broke out in Zangalpora village of Devsar in south Kashmir’s Kulgam district on Wednesday morning, police sources said. A joint team of the Jammu and Kashmir Police, Army and paramilitary forces launched a cordon-and-search operation following specific inputs about the presence of militants in the village and Bhat was reported likely trapped during the operation. In a video call with Lateef, the army exhorted him to surrender but Lateef was seen refusing.
